text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy strives to change herself. 
Amidst this, she learns that her close 
friend, Sweep Tosho, is held in high 
expectation by Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Sweep Tosho had arrived at her 
grandmother's house together with her 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whenever someone gives Sweep Tosho orders, 
she feels as though she isn't being 
trusted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her grandmother offered the Trainer 
advice: focus not on guiding her, but on 
supporting her...
